column1: # Hand decisions for the Chinese lead-reading table (scripts/build_zh_reading_defaults.py reads this file).
# One row per word: surface, the reading that leads (numbered pinyin exactly as the ZH pack stores it), basis, gloss.
# basis = judgment: the reading the word most often has when it stands alone in running text, decided by review.
# basis = segmenter: neither reading clearly leads, so the reading HanLP gives the word on its own was kept.
# gloss = the first CC-CEDICT gloss of that reading, for review only; the build ignores it.
# basis = none (reading "-"): the word gets no row, so it keeps the pack's line order and, in a sentence, the
# reading HanLP gives it, as before the table. For a word no reading of which should be backed.
